scope: Discovery-only necessary-filter construction diagnostic on generated public Boolean quadratic systems. No complete new solver, external inputs, curves, scalars, production or rho workflow.
selection: Annihilate the internal low-quadratic coefficient span. Take non-pivot equation coordinates in increasing order. Minor r uses the cyclic window of five coordinates starting at offset r, r=0..3. Keep zero and duplicate minors; no yield-based row selection.
contract: Four maximal minors of the augmented 5-by-5 affine coefficient matrices are necessary consistency polynomials. Exact Boolean multiplication uses OR of monomial masks and XOR parity. Dynamic programming includes all permutations in characteristic two. Rank-deficient affine systems can make every minor zero while remaining inconsistent. Full affine recovery and original-equation checks are still required for a complete solver.
coefficient_contract: Each system compiles fresh matrices from its current coefficients. Polynomial coefficients and truth masks cannot be reused across changed systems. No support is inferred from another coefficient assignment. Zero polynomials, degree drops and duplicate minors are retained.
arms: numeric_minor4 evaluates the same four determinants directly at every outside assignment. symbolic_minor4 compiles four exact ANFs then transforms them to complete truth masks. affine_filter computes the stronger complete necessary affine consistency mask. The different predicates are explicit; filter-only costs are not complete-solver costs.
accounting: Each filter arm charges projection, allocation, coefficient construction, complete mask construction and temporary-workspace release in build_ns. total_ns additionally charges oracle-mask validation. Returned-mask destruction, fixtures, independent oracle construction, original truth-table checking and reference preparation are in worker receipts, outside arm clocks. Symbolic compilation includes measured parity updates and cap checks; no phase or observer cost is subtracted.
bound: For a complete solver retaining this fixed full-mask preprocessing, total cost is at least its preprocessing build_ns. The optimistic observed opportunity ratio is fastest retained complete-reference total_ns divided by symbolic build_ns, granting all later recovery free. It is conditional on this measured implementation and full-mask architecture, not a universal runtime or algorithmic lower bound.
decision: Evaluate six size/family discovery groups with paired 95 percent median-ratio intervals. A group whose upper bound is below 2 blocks a universal dramatic claim for the measured fixed preprocessing even with free recovery. Only lower bounds above 2 in all groups justify a complete candidate with fresh holdouts; they would not establish a speedup. Any failure/cap/missing cell is censored. No complete-solver or holdout promotion is made here.
correctness: Compare every minor truth bit against independent numeric elimination using direct projected evaluations of the original system. Compare affine masks against a row-elimination oracle. Enumerate every original assignment at these sizes and require every solution to survive both necessary filters. Preserve joint rejection counts and overlap, not sums of marginal rates.
